desc: Mount your Rapid Force Duty Holster to any hard surface with the Surface Mount accessory. The Rapid Force Surface Mount is perfect for storing your duty holster and firearm anywhere. The included wood screws, sheet metal screws, drywall anchors, and plastic screws make it easy to mount in a vehicle, under a desk, inside a cabinet, on a wall, or any other hard surface. The Surface Mount for the Rapid Force Duty Holster comes with a pre-installed QDS Receiver, which makes it compatible with their revolutionary Quick Disconnect System. Simply disconnect your duty holster from your carry configuration and slide it into the Surface Mount for quick and easy storage. The Surface Mount accessory requires a QDS attachment
